paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar son of Yannai, in Yochanan’s time; Elazar ben Antigonus’s teacher. I do not know who gave him this prophecy! If from Antigonus’s report in Yannai’s son’s name, Gittin 31, end of a, the reverse too occurs, Beitzah 34a. On his Yochanan-era dating, see below.
